resources.string: A comic & PDF reader focused on image quality, features and customizability. Opens CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT and PDF, folders of images, and WebP, JPEG XL, AVIF, TIFF and more. No ads, no tracking; works offline.
The app\'s own code is MIT; bundled components keep their own licenses
